execution_mode.description: The execution strategy for classify/stratify steps. When set to 'auto' the task decides automatically based on available memory.

oneOf.description: Process all holes sequentially within the current task. Best when the total memory requirement fits within the available budget.
oneOf.title: INLINE

oneOf.description: Dispatch each hole to a separate child task for parallel processing. Used when inline processing would risk an out-of-memory failure.
oneOf.title: FAN_OUT

oneOf.description: Automatically decide between inline and fan-out based on available memory. This is the default behaviour.
oneOf.title: AUTO

oneOf.description: A location was not classified or stratified because a required field is missing. `object_id` is the resolved location ID and `field` is the metadata key to supply. Fields required only by certain settings name the setting, e.g. 'Value is required to apply inverse filtering.'
oneOf.title: LOCATION_MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD

oneOf.description: A location was not classified or stratified because a field value is invalid, e.g. 'Value must not exceed 1.' or 'Value must be greater than 0.' `object_id` is the resolved location ID and `field` is the metadata key to correct; source-only fields must be corrected in the source data.
oneOf.title: LOCATION_INVALID_FIELD

oneOf.description: A metadata value is outside the typical range; the range is stated when known. `object_id` is the resolved location ID and `field` is the metadata key.
